question: Which country has the TALLEST people on average?

post.premise: Dutch men average 182.5 cm, and Americans fell to 37th
post.bait: Netherlands, Germany or the USA — which did you pick? 👇
post.sources_line: NCD-RisC (eLife 2016), Statistics Netherlands (CBS), BBC News, Wikipedia

copy.comment_cta: Did you get it, or did you say USA like everyone else?

intent: A doctor reading a growth chart out loud: friendly, precise, one surprise per line.

v04.text: The Netherlands. The average Dutch man is nearly 183 centimetres tall, the tallest on Earth.

v05.text: His great grandfather stood around 169. That is 13 centimetres gained in one century.

v06.text: American men were third tallest a century ago. Today they rank 37th.

v07.text: And the growing has stopped. Dutch people born after 1980 are no taller than their parents.

v08.text: Tall story, true numbers. Follow us.

research.topic: Which country has the tallest men? (Netherlands — NCD-RisC 2016: 182.5 cm for the 1996 birth cohort)

myths.reality: US men were 3rd tallest for the 1896 cohort (born 1896, measured 1914) and 37th for the 1996 cohort; Dutch men are tallest (NCD-RisC 2016).

landscape.our_gap: Feed answers say 'Netherlands' with a stock photo; nobody shows the century of growth, the US slide to 37th and the CBS 'growth stopped' finding on one map.
